user_notes: Use the seven originally requested dinners.
Pork chops should be slow cooked so they are tender.
Smash burgers should use wagyu beef.
Saturday pizza should have 4 assorted pies.
Do not combine roasted red peppers with mushrooms.
Mix the album pairings with artists who played Coachella 2026.

days.name: Sun 04/26
calendar_items: Laura out of town, Dan solo parent duty
time_constraints: Keep dinner mostly reheating and assembly.
days.dinner: Leftover Sunday Gravy Rigatoni with Meatballs & Sausage
days.dinner_description: A family-style red-sauce pasta built around leftover gravy, sturdy rigatoni, meatballs, sausage, and pecorino Romano.
days.dinner_notes: Use leftover gravy; loosen with pasta water and finish the pasta in the sauce.
days.album_description: A Coachella 2026 act pick with New York swagger, clipped guitars, and sharply drawn mini-scenes that make red-sauce Sunday feel like a little city movie.
days.album_sonic_description: Dry drums, interlocking downstroke guitars, laconic vocals, and lean bass lines with no wasted motion.
days.album_pairing_rationale: The Strokes bring downtown snap to a cozy Italian-American leftover night, keeping the meal from getting sleepy.
days.activity_notes: Cloudy solo-parent Sunday: keep the evening predictable and warm.
prep_notes: Check how much gravy is left before boiling pasta.
Prep cabbage rolls for Tuesday if time allows.

days.name: Mon 04/27
calendar_items: MTP Sovereign - Biweekly Staff Meeting 4:40 PM - 5:30 PM
Laura out of town, Dan solo parent duty
time_constraints: Late meeting and solo-parent logistics call for a fast dinner.
days.dinner: Wagyu Ultra-Smashed Cheeseburgers with Pickles & Secret Sauce
days.dinner_description: Thin wagyu beef patties smashed hard on a hot griddle, stacked with American cheese, pickles, shredded lettuce, and burger sauce.
days.dinner_notes: Use wagyu beef; portion into small loose balls before the meeting so dinner moves quickly afterward.
days.album_description: A Coachella 2026 act pick that turns hardcore momentum into a surprisingly sunny, communal record.
days.album_sonic_description: Hard-charging drums, chunky guitars, melodic shouts, handclaps, and sudden flashes of dream-pop color.
days.album_pairing_rationale: Smash burgers want speed, sizzle, and joy; Turnstile sounds like the griddle at full heat.
days.activity_notes: Let Elsie build her own burger so the meal feels playful instead of rushed.
prep_notes: Mix burger sauce earlier in the day.
Wash lettuce and slice pickles before cooking.

days.name: Tue 04/28
days.weather_detail: Mostly Sunny (70% sunshine), wind 11 mph, 33% precip
calendar_items: IcM Agent Studio Agent Loop Lab Series 4:00 PM - 5:00 PM
time_constraints: On-call start, swim lessons, and late meetings make prep-beforehand pasta logistics important.
days.dinner: Babo Pasta: Egg-Yolk Spinach Tagliatelle with Brown Butter & Parm
days.dinner_description: Egg-yolk pasta is all silk and richness, and spinach gives the tagliatelle that deep green color. Brown butter and Parmigiano-Reggiano keep it simple enough that the handmade noodles stay the point.
days.dinner_notes: Prep the dough or at least stage the pasta tools before swim; brown the butter only when everyone is home.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: See the nutrition section for how lunches and snacks balance this dinner.
days.album: Little Simz - Sometimes I Might Be Introvert
days.album_description: Little Simz’s 2021 Sometimes I Might Be Introvert won the Mercury Prize by making private reflection feel orchestral and bold. It has the sweep of a film score and the intimacy of a journal.
days.album_sonic_description: Orchestral swells, crisp drums, choral voices, deep bass, and precise rapping that moves like a stage monologue with a rhythm section.
days.album_pairing_rationale: Handmade pasta rewards attention; Little Simz turns that same inward focus into something grand.
days.activity_notes: Make the dough or stage ingredients before swim; keep Elsie's job small and satisfying.
prep_notes: Buy extra eggs for yolk-only dough.
Cook spinach dry enough that the dough does not turn sticky.
Stage flour, semolina, and the pasta tools before swim.

days.name: Wed 04/29
days.weather_detail: Mostly Cloudy (56% sunshine), wind 12 mph, 87% precip
time_constraints: Rain and travel return favor a hands-off slow-cooker dinner.
days.dinner: Slow-Cooked Pork Chops with Mushroom Cream Sauce
days.dinner_description: Tender slow-cooked pork chops finished with a silky mushroom cream sauce, thyme, garlic, Dijon mustard, and pan juices.
days.dinner_notes: Adapt to slow cooker so the chops stay tender. Keep mushrooms with cream and herbs; no roasted red peppers.
days.album_description: A Coachella 2026 artist pick with sleek late-night grooves and intimate stories about longing, identity, and trying to stay soft in a hard city.
days.album_sonic_description: Slinky bass, glassy synths, clipped funk guitar, saxophone haze, and feather-light vocals.
days.album_pairing_rationale: The mushroom cream sauce is rich and soft; Blood Orange gives the rainy night a graceful pulse.
days.activity_notes: A good night for everyone to come back under one roof.
prep_notes: Season pork chops the night before.

days.name: Thu 04/30
days.weather_detail: Sunny (91% sunshine), wind 16 mph with gusts up to 33 mph, 68% precip
time_constraints: Dan on call; make-ahead cabbage rolls keep a drizzly night calm and reheat-friendly.
days.dinner_description: Stuffed cabbage rolls show up across Eastern European and Jewish kitchens because they are thrifty, tender, and built for feeding people well. This version leans sweet-savory, with cabbage leaves wrapping a plush beef-and-rice filling.
days.dinner_notes: Make ahead or assemble earlier; reheat gently with extra sauce so the rolls stay tender.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: See the nutrition section for how lunches and snacks balance this dinner.
days.album_mood: Warm, theatrical, streetwise, and sing-along friendly.
days.album_description: Billy Joel’s 1977 The Stranger, produced by Phil Ramone, is full of booth-at-the-diner characters and piano hooks. It invites stories instead of disappearing into the background.
days.album_sonic_description: Piano-led pop rock with saxophone hooks, brisk drums, Broadway flair, and tight late-70s studio polish.
days.album_pairing_rationale: Cabbage rolls and Billy Joel both feel like someone at the table has a story to tell.
days.activity_notes: Serve the rolls warm and saucy, then keep the evening simple and early.
prep_notes: Blanch cabbage leaves and mix filling ahead.
Reheat covered with extra sauce so the rolls stay tender.

days.name: Fri 05/01
days.weather_detail: Mostly Sunny (76% sunshine), wind 10 mph with gusts up to 27 mph, 18% precip
time_constraints: Friday can support a bright fish dinner if the on-call queue stays quiet.
days.dinner: Greek-Style Roasted Branzino with Garlicky Kale
days.dinner_description: Branzino is a Mediterranean sea bass that loves whole roasting with olive oil, herbs, and decisive heat. Ladolemono—Greek lemon and olive oil sauce—ties the fish to garlicky kale and wakes up the plate.
days.dinner_notes: Keep it bright and simple; the fish balances the week's red meat and dairy.
days.dinner_nutrition_notes: See the nutrition section for how lunches and snacks balance this dinner.
days.album_description: Karol G’s 2023 Mañana Será Bonito turns recovery into color, movement, and big melodic confidence. Its reggaeton-pop brightness keeps the drizzle from setting the tone.
days.album_sonic_description: Reggaeton bounce, Caribbean percussion, glossy pop choruses, acoustic color, and warm low-end movement.
days.album_pairing_rationale: Lemon, herbs, and kale ask for lift; Karol G supplies sunshine without forcing cheer.
days.activity_notes: Let Elsie help whisk the lemon-olive oil sauce or season her own small fish flake.
prep_notes: Ask the fishmonger to clean the branzino.
Whisk the ladolemono just before serving.

days.name: Sat 05/02
days.weather_detail: Sunny (99% sunshine), wind 13 mph with gusts up to 27 mph, 22% precip
time_constraints: Visitor night: make dinner festive, flexible, and easy to share.
days.dinner_description: A visitor-night pizza spread with four assorted pies, including a spring shaved asparagus white pizza plus family-friendly classics.
days.dinner_notes: Make 4 assorted pies. If using mushrooms, keep roasted red peppers on a different pie.
days.album_description: A Coachella 2026 act pick built for a room with guests, bubbling cheese, and people drifting between the kitchen and the table.
days.album_sonic_description: Four-on-the-floor drums, clipped vocal samples, rubbery bass, Afro-house percussion, and glossy festival-scale hooks.
days.album_pairing_rationale: Four pizzas and a visitor call for momentum; Disclosure keeps the kitchen moving without drowning out conversation.
days.activity_notes: Sunny visitor Saturday: keep toppings modular and let everyone claim a pie.
prep_notes: Make or buy enough dough for four pies.
Stage toppings in bowls before baking.
Keep mushrooms and roasted red peppers separated.
